subject: [PATCH RESEND 3/7] locking/mutex: track holders of opted-in mutexes

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch introduces a feature to track the holders of opted-in mutexes in Linux. It adds a function called `mutex_track_holder` that allows developers to opt-in mutexes for holder tracking. The function is used to count the number of locks held by a task, which can help identify potential bottlenecks and stalls in the system. The patch also includes changes to handle PREEMPT_RT builds and ensures that the tracking flag survives even after the lock has been released. The feature is opt-in, meaning it only applies to mutexes that have explicitly opted-in for holder tracking.
